---
title: "EVD Toolkit"
---

A practical, visual, and interactive educational tool designed to improve understanding, safety, and standardization of External Ventricular Drain (EVD) care.

```{ojs}
visitorCount = {
  const { initializeApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js");
  const { getFirestore, doc, onSnapshot, updateDoc, increment } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD1FLnIrd86qOsFPLi5y1q_EIU0lhL5gxc",
    authDomain: "evdtoolkit.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "evdtoolkit",
    storageBucket: "evdtoolkit.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "1002374431151",
    appId: "1:1002374431151:web:fe3724bb1f39eb4744af5a"
  };

  const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const db = getFirestore(app);
  const counterRef = doc(db, "Stats", "visitorCount");

  // Count this page load. Fails silently if the counter document
  // hasn't been created yet in Firestore.
  updateDoc(counterRef, { count: increment(1) }).catch(() => {});

  // Live listener — the number updates in real time for every visitor
  // currently on the page, as new visitors arrive.
  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(counterRef, snapshot => {
      notify(snapshot.data()?.count ?? 0);
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
html`<div style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#f0f4ff;color:#2c3e50;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 18px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:20px;">
  <span>👀</span>
  <span>${visitorCount.toLocaleString()} visitors and counting</span>
</div>`
```

## About This Project

EVD practices vary widely across institutions, particularly in device setup, leveling, and management. This variability can lead to confusion, communication gaps, and potential safety risks.

The goal of this toolkit is to provide a standardized, visual, and practical approach to EVD education while recognizing real-world variability in systems and workflows.
